rhymes_hint: 3D-glass-render icons (Spline/Blender translucent single-object forms on black — rings/loops/knots/blobs); the current indie/AI-tool glass wave and Apple's own Liquid Glass demo forms. Candidate 'monochrome glass-object on near-black' family, trend-committed and subject-mute.
notes: Clean native 1024x1024 master, no upscale smear — measurements reliable. Ring dead-centered (bbox 834x842, center 509,511, ~9% uniform margins), background perfectly flat #08060E (no vignette). Subject mismatch: app is a dev disk-cleanup/health tool but the icon is an abstract glass ring communicating neither cleanup nor dev. Brand-palette partial coherence: cover UI is dark near-black with an ORANGE primary accent (~#F59E0B) + semantic status dots; icon shares only the dark ground and drops the orange identity entirely, carrying zero chroma. Reads as generic premium-glass, not specifically Room Service. Two failures (#7, #10) both stem from the same root: a baked, dark-committed single-image render rather than separable layers — the icon is dark-mode-first and background-dependent by construction.
